_readme: SHARED SET LISTS — the coordination file. This is the memory.
The queue in your browser is your own scratch pad (localStorage). This file
is what the three of you agree on: it is committed, so git is the sync, the
diff is the history, and a merge conflict is a real conversation about the
set rather than two people silently overwriting each other.
It is baked into index.html at build time, which is the point — the OFFLINE
show artifact carries the set list with it, so a fresh show laptop on playa
opens with the real running order instead of 43 scenes sorted by number.
TO CHANGE A SET: build it in the browser, hit COPY FOR REPO in the QUEUE
drawer, paste the block in here (or just hand it to Claude in a session and
say which set it is), then commit and push. Order matters — it IS the
running order.
A scenes[] entry is either a bare id ("SRC-15") or an object carrying that
scene's show settings: {"id":"SRC-15","min":6,"out":"midi"}. `min` is
minutes on stage before SHOWTIME auto-advances (default 10); `out` pins the
sound routing while that scene is up (web | both | midi — omit to follow
the global OUT toggle). Bare ids leave a browser's local settings alone.
`default: true` marks the set a browser with no queue of its own loads.
Every set in here should be one somebody actually built and stands behind.
The two provisional examples this file shipped with are gone — a shelf of
sets nobody chose just makes the real one harder to find.

sets.name: RUN OF SHOW
sets.note: Lance, Aug 2026 — the Nine minus Weather Station (SRC-10): eight scenes, same arc. Chladni's sand finds the silent lines, Lumen Film opens the aperture, Ferro Bloom puts the colour on, Ridge Loom takes the room wide, then it narrows — Attractor Vespers to smoke, White Study to black and white, Rain Atrium to a dark pool, and Cable Strum leaves one string in the air. OUT casting carried over from the Nine unchanged.

sets.name: THE MAGNIFICENT NINE
sets.note: Lance, Aug 2026 — the favourite set so far. Nine scenes that hold up on the wall, in this order: Chladni's sand finds the silent lines, Lumen Film opens the aperture, Ferro Bloom puts the colour on, Ridge Loom and Weather Station take the room wide, then it narrows — Attractor Vespers to smoke, White Study to black and white, Rain Atrium to a dark pool, and Cable Strum leaves one string in the air. OUT casting baked from docs/ABLETON-RIG.md (Rain: midi per the V20 loop-is-the-kit round; Chladni: both carries the browser bells; Weather/others per the table).

sets.name: DJ SET
sets.note: Nima, Aug 2026 — the audio-in scenes: they draw what they hear. This is the set for when a DJ is the instrument. Connect the source in MAP → Audio in (line-in, mic, or CAPTURE APP AUDIO) and SET REST with the room quiet before the first track, or silence won't read as silence. All want a full spectrum with a real kick. The arc: Spectrum Halo reads the track literally as one exposed plate, Penrose Bloom grows a crystal out of it, Cloud Steam flies the sky forward one surge per beat — then Lance's adapted trio (Aug 31 round, the structural listeners: they read the new build/drop detector): Chladni Court lets the spectrum choose the plate's resonance and the drop opens its violet unlock, White Study fills its grid with the DJ's hats and pumps to the real kick, and Event Horizon closes — the kick strums the cable and the drop opens the 2001 stargate. The trio keeps its hand instruments (silent without a player, OUT pinned to web so nothing reaches Live) — a visitor at the pedestal can jam over the booth. Cell Front (SRC-43) is deliberately OUT of this set. MIN 15 because a DJ set is long-form.
